# Source: saved scheduler settings read from the database (a job with no saved row uses its registry default).
# Re-render and reinstall this file after ANY scheduler change in Settings, and after every deploy.
# Layout: cron.d (every job line has a user field). Install as /etc/cron.d/<name without dots>, root:root, mode 0644.
# --- OTI CRON START ---
# Managed by One Two Inventory — do not edit manually
# CRON_SECRET is read from /etc/ims/cron.env at runtime — rotating it needs no crontab re-sync.
BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/cron"

# Alpha Job
25 * * * *  root  CRON_SECRET=$(grep -m1 '^CRON_SECRET=' '/etc/ims/cron.env' | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); case "$CRON_SECRET" in ''|*\\*) echo "cron-auth: CRON_SECRET is missing or unusable (empty, or holds a backslash); alpha was not run" ;; *) echo "header = \"Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET\"" | curl -sf -o /dev/null -K - "$BASE_URL/alpha" ;; esac >> '/var/log/ims/cron.log' 2>&1

# Read Sync Liveness
*/5 * * * *  root  CRON_SECRET=$(grep -m1 '^CRON_SECRET=' '/etc/ims/cron.env' | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); case "$CRON_SECRET" in ''|*\\*) echo "cron-auth: CRON_SECRET is missing or unusable (empty, or holds a backslash); read-sync-liveness was not run" ;; *) echo "header = \"Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET\"" | curl -sf -o /dev/null -K - "$BASE_URL/read-sync-liveness" ;; esac >> '/var/log/ims/cron.log' 2>&1

# --- OTI CRON END ---
